runbooks.diagnosis: Invoice Ninja's PHP app crashes at boot when the app key changed under an existing database (APP_KEY mismatch makes encrypted columns undecryptable) or when migrations run concurrently from scaled containers.
remediation: Never change APP_KEY on an existing install without re-encrypting
Ensure only one container runs migrations at a time
Check laravel.log for the concrete exception before restarting

runbooks.diagnosis: Invoice Ninja uses its own SMTP settings stored in the database, not the stack-wide env. Stale SMTP rows point at dead hosts after a mail server change.
remediation: Update the SMTP settings in the Invoice Ninja UI/database settings
Test with the built-in 'send test email' before restarting anything

symptoms: invoiceninja exit 1 mysql server has gone away
invoiceninja pdo driver could not find driver
runbooks.diagnosis: Three independent traps when deploying invoiceninja against postgres: (1) Laravel reads DB_CONNECTION, not the DB_TYPE documented by invoiceninja — without DB_CONNECTION the mysql driver is used and fails with 'MySQL server has gone away' against postgres. (2) The upstream image only ships pdo_mysql/pdo_sqlite — 'could not find driver (Connection: pgsql)' means the pgsql PHP extension is missing entirely; it must be baked via the local build (services/invoice-ninja/Dockerfile, apk + docker-php-ext-install pdo_pgsql; build as USER root — base runs as uid 1500, image is Alpine not Debian). (3) Even with the driver, v5 migrations contain MySQL-dialect SQL (ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN) and fail on postgres with syntax error at 'modify' — postgres is unsupported upstream; deploy the dedicated MariaDB (invoiceninja-db) instead.
remediation: Use the local build image invoiceninja-pg:5 (build: ./services/invoice-ninja) if pgsql is ever needed
Use the invoiceninja-db MariaDB service (DB_HOST=invoiceninja-db:3306) — the supported path
Sync the role password: ALTER USER invoiceninja_user with the .env INVOICENINJA_DB_PASSWORD if it drifted

symptoms: invoiceninja healthcheck fails curl connection refused
runbooks.diagnosis: invoiceninja:5 is an FPM image — port 9000 speaks FastCGI, not HTTP. A healthcheck or traefik service pointing at localhost:9000/health fails ('connection refused' or '000'). Traefik must route to the invoiceninja-web nginx front (port 80), which serves the shared invoiceninja-public volume and fastcgi_passes to invoiceninja:9000. Note: localhost in alpine busybox resolves ::1 — nginx listens v4 only, use 127.0.0.1 in healthchecks.
remediation: Route the traefik invoices router to invoiceninja-web:80 (host-only compose.internal.yml overrides the labels)
Healthcheck fpm via pgrep php-fpm; healthcheck web via wget http://127.0.0.1:80/health
First boot takes 2-3 min (composer + migrations + seeding) — RestartCount 3-4 with exit 0 during init is normal
